insertion.algorithm: encode the fixed messages once; require neutral_fragment_token_ids has length one; insert repetitions immediately after the first im_start/user/line-feed prefix and before every original user-content token; choose repetitions so final prompt_token_ids length equals target_prompt_tokens

prompt_constructor.algorithm: call tokenizer.apply_chat_template with exactly chat_template_call; tokenizer and tokenizer_config raw bytes must match the rung manifest; obtain base token array B; encode neutral_fragment with add_special_tokens=false as N and require length(N)=1; locate the unique user-content start U by encoding the exact user content and finding exact contiguous equality inside B; for target T require T>=length(B), define R as B[0:U] + N repeated (T-length(B)) + B[U:]; reject zero/multiple U matches; rendered_prompt is tokenizer.decode(R,skip_special_tokens=false,clean_up_tokenization_spaces=false); require tokenizer.encode(rendered_prompt,add_special_tokens=false)==R
